record.title: Appointed investment manager of a reserve fund
record.sub: Manage reserve assets · Advise or manage investments
kv: The fund’s governing and advisory documents allocate discretion; the applicable adviser and fund requirements apply independently.
Reserve exposure is held through a fund whose investment manager exercises the investment mandate.
Investment managers with the applicable regulatory status and an effective fund mandate

Identify the exact fund and investment-manager legal entity. Recover the current advisory mandate, investment limits and board oversight. Keep the fund’s asset custody and issuer’s redemption obligations separate.
The filing supports a named Circle Reserve Fund arrangement, not blanket powers for the BlackRock parent or every reserve asset.
BlackRock Advisors, LLC: Circle’s April 18, 2025 S-1/A names this exact entity as investment manager of Circle Reserve Fund, subject to the fund board.
